_doc: Catalog of every figure/chart in the IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026, recording its CHART TYPE, encoding (axes/series), and what it showed. Lets an agent know which kind of graph was used for each topic without the image. Chart types used in the report: line, bar (vertical/horizontal), stacked-bar, 100%-stacked-bar, scatter, bubble-scatter, dual-axis (rare), heatmap-matrix, flowchart-diagram, waterfall, table. Page numbers from the PDF. Numeric values live in the sibling JSON files.
